messages:
maria.chen: Quick async check — posting a short status for the eventing / token-cost attribution work. TL;DR: schema stable, one blocking test flake in metrics ingest, dependency on eng-runtime for header passthrough. Need owners for rollout gating (canary + smoke).

maria.chen: Current checklist: 1) finalize event schema (v3) for token attribution, 2) add server header for request-cost-id (eng-runtime), 3) smoke test that latency buckets are emitted, 4) PR + rollout plan for canary routing.

maria.chen: Pushing a small schema diff here: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "token_cost",
  "version": "v3",
  "fields": {
    "request_id": "string",
    "model": "string",
    "token_count": "int",
    "latency_ms": "int",
    "cost_usd": "float",
    "route": "string"
  }
}
```

ajay.patel: thanks — looks good. question: are we planning to surface cost_usd at ingest or compute downstream in analytics?

maria.chen: prefer compute downstream to keep edge writes lighter; but we need deterministic token_count at ingest. For now include token_count and latency_ms; cost_usd optional during ingest.

sophia.kim: I can own the analytics mapping and the downstream cost calc. I'll add the transform spec to the analytics repo by EOD.

sam_w: FYI eng-runtime: we need a new header `x-request-cost-id` so exporters can correlate traces -> events. @eng-runtime PTAL — this is the blocker for the smoke test.

sam_w: sample header expected: `x-request-cost-id: <uuid>` same lifecycle as request_id.

ajay.patel: I can add a small passthrough in runtime, but timeline depends on a short design question — do we generate the request-cost-id at the edge or rely on the API gateway?

maria.chen: prefer gateway generate. fallback: runtime generates if missing. Need an owner from infra/gateway to confirm. @sophia.kim can you ping infra?

sophia.kim: pinged infra on #eng-infra. they said gateway team can add it next deploy window (Tue). If they can't, Ajay, please implement fallback generator.

analytics-bot: PR opened: analytics/etl#342 (transform spec + cost calc). link: https://git.redwood.ai/analytics/etl/pull/342

ajay.patel: I'll draft the runtime PR today: runtime/patches#128 — it will: 1) accept `x-request-cost-id` if present, 2) generate uuidv4 if missing, 3) emit header in downstream calls. Can someone add me to the runtime reviewers? @sam_w

sam_w: added you to reviewers. Also, test matrix: need a unit test for header passthrough + an integration smoke that asserts event contains request_id and token_count.

maria.chen: Smoke plan (short): deploy runtime patch to dev, run 1-minute traffic replay against canary route, assert events for 1000 requests contain token_count + request-cost-id and no missing latency_ms. If >1% missing -> rollback.

sophia.kim: For the latency buckets: we'll emit a `latency_bucket` derived field in analytics (<=50, 51-200, 201-500, >500) and use that for dashboards. I'll add that to PR 342.

ajay.patel: One more: schema bumpable field list? If we add optional fields later we shouldn't break older consumers. So v3 must be backwards compatible. Add a `metadata` map for anything future.

maria.chen: good call — adding `metadata: map<string,string>` to the schema now. will update gist.

sam_w: blockers summary: infra to add header on gateway (Tues) OR runtime fallback (Ajay). analytics PR merged (Sophia), runtime PR + unit tests (Ajay) -> then smoke canary.

ajay.patel: I expect to have PR up by 16:00 PT. will mark WIP and request reviews.

sophia.kim: I'll finish transform tests and a small smoke script that reads events and validates fields. ETA EOD.

maria.chen: Action items: 
- infra/gateway: confirm Tue deploy (owner: @infra-gateway)
- ajay.patel: runtime PR + tests (owner)
- sophia.kim: analytics transform + smoke assertions (owner)
- sam_w: coordinate canary rollout & monitor (owner)

maria.chen: Can everyone drop a quick ack if owning the item? :thumbsup:

ajay.patel: :thumbsup: owning runtime PR

sophia.kim: :thumbsup: owning analytics + smoke script

sam_w: :thumbsup: will coordinate canary and watch alerts

infra-gateway (bot): Confirmed — gateway team can add header on Tue deploy window. Owner: @chris.gateway.

maria.chen: Great. Plan: target canary smoke Wed morning. I'll schedule a 15-min sync Wed 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. If anything crops up here, drop updates in this thread. Thanks all.

ajay.patel: one more tiny ask — can we add a sentinel metric `token_attrib.events_missing_request_cost_id` so ops can detect regressions post-rollout?

sam_w: yes. I'll add an alert when we hit >0.5% missing over 5m.

maria.chen: perfect. Closing this update — will post canary link in thread once started.
